endpoint: Future hot-run validation log-perplexity after an early 20B-token prefix, through 100B tokens
data_level: Author-merged and filtered computational training logs; not raw hardware telemetry
selection: All 22 pretrain=True,cooldown=False rows from wandb_df_raw; linked summary chunks used only for provenance crosschecks; no cooldown/lr-ablation rows mixed
calibration: Latest finite positive loss at token count <=20e9 and latest <=10e9; fixed prior windows. No later held architecture loss as predictor. Actual anchor token counts explicit.
time: Token count = optimizer_step * 2048 * 2048; steps interpreted numerically, not lexical JSON key order; targets20e9<T<=100e9.
groups: Complete architecture model_id; 5 metadata-stratified confirmation architectures; development17 leave-one-architecture-out folds
metric: Equally weighted architecture MAE in nats/token; physical RMSE, bias, all groups and late horizon strata as complementary
baseline_families: log-token tangent from two calibration anchors
nested grouped RBF flexible model with same early anchors/architecture/token inputs
selection_rule: Smallest development whole-architecture MAE; within1% choose fewer fitted parameters. Select among all baselines/candidates.
attempts: At least5 distinct hypotheses, then continue only defensible development-led revision; stop after2 consecutive attempts with no predictive/robustness/interpretation gain
uncertainty: Individual5 architecture results; descriptive resampling if used cannot claim new seed/corpus populations.
confirmation: Separate command verifies code/model hash freeze and performs no fitting/reselection; no confirmation scores before stopping
exposure: Public source paper known; schema-stage only architecture/config/step metadata inspected.
